title: tac.configure
description: Picture settings for every side (human, referee or director only): fog (IFF unknown until identified), revealNames, dropAfterS for tracks no longer held, and sampleHz, the main-thread snapshot rate that drives the picture, the missile ledger and source.tactical (1-10 Hz, default 5). Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

dropAfterS.description: drop tracks not held for this long

sampleHz.description: snapshot rate of the picture and missile ledger
